definitions.short: Ebed , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5651. Ebed II. עֶ֫בֶד proper name, masculine ( servant of God = עַבְדְּאֵל ); — 1 father of Gaal Judg 9:26 , 28 , 30 , 31 , 35 (GFM, after Hollenb ThLz 1891, 371 [compare Bu Ib. 1892, 63 ] עֹבֵד , as ᵐ5 L ; see also Gray Prop. N. 184, 272 ); ᵐ5 Ιωβηλ , A ᵐ5 L Αβεδ . 2 a companion of Ezra Ezra 8:6 ; ᵐ5 Ωβηθ , ᵐ5 L Αμιναδαβ . — For list of Arabic names beginning with see Nö ZMG xli (1887), 724 ff. , compare also Id ib, xlii (1888), 486 We Heid. 2, 2 ff .

occurrences.englishText: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?
When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.
He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.
Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.
Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
